accounting.capital_reservation: At entry, reserved = quantity * entry_fill_price; cash must cover reserved plus the entry fee. Reserved returns to cash at exit.
accounting.insufficient_capital: Entry is skipped with reason INSUFFICIENT_FREE_CASH; the signal is never silently dropped.
accounting.marking: Equity is marked at every native M5 close while a position is open, and at every exit.
accounting.pnl_components: gross_pnl uses zero-cost open prices; friction_pnl is the slippage-only difference between fill and open prices; fee_pnl is the negative sum of both sides' fees; net_pnl is their sum. The three components are disjoint and never double counted.
accounting.quantity: quantity = ENTRY_NOTIONAL_USDT / entry_fill_price, so deployed entry notional is the fixed research constant.
accounting.simulation_constants_note: Research constants, not live sizing recommendations.

costs.fee_basis: Binance USD-M defaults from app/core/constants.py; illustrative research assumptions, not verified account fees.
costs.frozen_note: The full grid was frozen before any performance number was computed, and every scenario is reported.

evaluation_window.note: Same documented Phase 1 requested window, and wider than the M15 diagnostic's matched descriptive window so both policies face an identical opportunity set.
evaluation_window.signal_semantics: M15 trigger-close timestamps inside the window, inclusive

execution.entry: Open of the first existing native M5 candle whose open time is strictly after the signal-close timestamp.
execution.exit: Open of the native M5 candle whose open time equals the entry open time plus exactly 60 minutes.
execution.proxies: Delayed candle-price proxies, not guaranteed fills.
execution.same_timestamp_ordering: Scheduled exits are processed before scheduled entries.
execution.while_open: A signal arriving while a position is open queues at most one deferred entry at that position's scheduled exit time; further signals are skipped.

funding.consequence: Every cost-adjusted result is 'After assumed trading fees and slippage, before funding.' and is not fully net profit.
funding.cost_adjusted_label: After assumed trading fees and slippage, before funding.
funding.decision: Perpetual funding is deliberately excluded from this offline reference backtest; no funding data was downloaded and no funding accounting was implemented.
funding.entry_exit_unchanged: Entry and exit rules were not adjusted to dodge or capture funding settlements.
funding.not_zero: Excluded funding must never be read as observed zero funding. Real funding could have been a cost or a credit, and it is not measured here.

missing_data.evaluation_end: A position still open at the window end is labelled OPEN_AT_EVALUATION_END, marked but not force-closed, and excluded from realized P&L.
missing_data.missing_entry_candle: Skipped with reason MISSING_ENTRY_CANDLE; no later candle is substituted.
missing_data.missing_exit_candle: Reported as UNRESOLVED_MISSING_EXIT_CANDLE; no price is substituted and the position stays open, blocking new exposure.
missing_data.no_future_information: Accepting a trade never depends on any data after its scheduled execution time.
missing_data.unresolved_trades: Excluded from realized P&L and reported separately with an explicit count.

policies.A_emitted_alerts: Emitted replay M15 alerts, unchanged; the replay's one-hour per-timeframe cooldown is already applied.
policies.B_gate_cooldown: Preparation-ready M15 bars with M15, H1 and H4 closes all strictly above native EMA21, no RSI crossover requirement, with an independent one-hour signal cooldown initialised at the window start.
policies.cooldown_rule: A bar is accepted when its close is at least 60 minutes after the previously accepted close; identical to the replay's suppression rule.
policies.difference_from_diagnostic_population: The M15 diagnostic's gate_ready_no_cross population (38,292 bars) had NO cooldown and is not policy B. Policy B applies the one-hour cooldown, so it is a much smaller signal set whose accepted bars are at least 60 minutes apart.
